描述_EN: antonio claudio carvalho (born brazil; lives uk) is best known as a painter and a poet, but is increasingly focused on printmaking – particularly screen printing.this print is an artist's book which takes the form of a single concertina-folded sheet, printed with a poem by carvalho. this is the first of twelve artists’ books which responds to the saison poetry library’s collection as part of art on poetry at the south bank, london. the poem was written in situ during the artist's first visit to china, and references such icons of poetry such as gregory corso, allen ginsberg and frank o'hara. the poem is presented as a sequence of images referencing the titles of important influential poems and poetry books, with an emphasis on radical literature and protest. these iconic titles are presented like newspaper sellers’ placards, suggesting an immediacy and urgency in the message which poetry can carry in a political context.
描述_ZN: antonio claudio carvalho (born brazil; lives uk) is best known as a painter and a poet, but is increasingly focused on printmaking – particularly screen printing.this print is an artist's book which takes the form of a single concertina-folded sheet, printed with a poem by carvalho. 这是十二本艺术家的书中的第一本，作为伦敦南岸诗歌艺术的一部分，回应了Saison诗歌图书馆的收藏。 这首诗是在艺术家第一次访问中国时就地写的，并参考了格雷戈里-科尔索、艾伦-金斯伯格和弗兰克-奥哈拉等诗歌的代表。 这首诗以一连串的图像呈现，参考了重要的有影响力的诗歌和诗集的标题，强调了激进的文学和抗议。 这些标志性的标题像卖报人的标语牌一样呈现，暗示了诗歌在政治背景下所承载的信息的即时性和紧迫性。
